issues.description: Breaking rename of public frame class without deprecation alias
issues.detail: `RequestMetadataFrame` is removed outright from pipecat.frames.frames and replaced with `ServiceSwitcherRequestMetadataFrame`. Any downstream user code importing `RequestMetadataFrame` will fail with ImportError on upgrade. Consider keeping a deprecation alias (e.g. `RequestMetadataFrame = ServiceSwitcherRequestMetadataFrame`) with a DeprecationWarning for at least one release.

issues.description: Required `service` field uses forward-reference string and lacks default; dataclass may pickle/serialize poorly
issues.detail: The new field `service: "FrameProcessor"` is a required dataclass field referencing a runtime object. ControlFrames are sometimes serialized/logged; embedding a live FrameProcessor reference can cause repr blowups, cyclic references, and pickling failures. Consider storing a stable identifier (e.g. service name or id) instead of the processor instance.

issues.description: Frame now leaks downstream to non-switcher pipelines
issues.detail: STTService and the mock now push `ServiceSwitcherRequestMetadataFrame` downstream after handling. When STT is used outside a ServiceSwitcher, this internal control frame escapes into the user's pipeline with a reference to the service object. Downstream processors will see an unfamiliar frame; consider only forwarding when in a switcher context, or document as public API.

issues.description: Identity comparison via `==` on FrameProcessor may misbehave
issues.detail: `frame.service == self.strategy.active_service` relies on dataclass/object equality. If FrameProcessor subclasses ever override `__eq__` (or are dataclasses themselves), this could match the wrong service. Identity check (`is`) is safer and clearer here since we're comparing the exact processor instance.

issues.description: No test coverage for non-active-service targeting case
issues.detail: The new conditional `if frame.service == self.strategy.active_service` only suppresses the frame when targeting the active service. There's no test for the case where the frame targets a non-active service (e.g. via stale routing), which would now leak past the switcher. Add a regression test exercising both branches.

issues.description: Changelog entry doesn't flag this as a breaking change
issues.detail: The changelog file is named `3692.changed.md` but the rename removes a public symbol with no alias. Users tracking changelogs for breaking changes may miss this. Consider renaming to `3692.breaking.md` or `3692.removed.md` depending on the project's towncrier categories, and noting the import-path break explicitly.

review.summary: The rename and added `service` targeting is mechanically clean and the existing tests are updated correctly, but the change has a few real concerns. It removes a public frame class with no deprecation alias, embeds a live FrameProcessor reference into a control-frame dataclass (serialization/repr hazards), and starts forwarding what was previously an internal frame downstream from STTService — leaking it outside ServiceSwitcher contexts. Equality comparison on processor instances and missing coverage for the non-matching-service branch are smaller issues worth tightening before merge.
